bundlePurpose: Version-controlled non-secret Lisa definition and deployment input.
liveRuntimeRule: The running VPS profile is runtime truth. This bundle is deployed only through a reviewed materialization step and must not replace mutable state wholesale.
eligibleContent: reviewed operating instructions, skills, templates, and agent documentation
non-secret deployment manifests and source code
excludedContent: gateway tokens, passwords, OAuth material, private keys, and Google Secret Manager values
OpenClaw runtime configuration snapshots unless explicitly redacted and approved
device pairings, session transcripts, logs, caches, SQLite databases, and dynamic runtime state
raw private memory and user data

vpsMissingOnly: two disposable Ship/Pull scratch status reports
comparisonReceipt.result: No durable non-secret identity, personality, agent, or knowledge document was missing from the VPS comparison.

restoreContract.code: Deploy the approved OpenClaw Prime revision.
restoreContract.definition: Materialize only reviewed, non-secret bundle content.
restoreContract.secrets: Resolve Google Secret Manager references at runtime.
restoreContract.mutableState: Restore only from encrypted off-VPS backup. Git is not a backup for live state.
